description.value: Coyote's Coffee is mapped as a café in Nanaimo, though the associated website belongs to a distinct Parksville business — Coyote Coffee Roastery — which operates as a small-batch specialty roaster sourcing beans from 15–20 countries via direct-trade and certified ethical channels. The roastery sells whole-bean coffee online and through a physical Parksville location, with in-store pickup available. Independent ground-truth verification of the Nanaimo node is needed before this listing can be accurately described.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM node 'Coyote's Coffee' is geolocated in Nanaimo (49.16°N, 123.89°W), but the auto-discovered website (coyotescoffee.ca) belongs to 'Coyote Coffee Roastery' at 30-1499 Huntley Road, Parksville BC — a different municipality roughly 30 km north. The business name, physical address, and OSM opening hours all conflict sharply with website content (OSM lists café-style hours 7 days a week; website shows Mon–Fri roastery hours, closed weekends). The URL was discovered with only medium confidence and almost certainly does not match this OSM node; all amenity data from the website is therefore unreliable for this listing.
